items.followUp: Write two differences between a cation and an anion.

rubric.why: An ion is distinguished by having a charge, usually because it has lost or gained electrons.
rubric.description: States how an ion differs from a free radical.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying an ion as charged or explaining that it gains or loses electrons.

rubric.why: A free radical is characterized by unpaired electrons and may exist independently.
rubric.description: States the defining feature of a free radical.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a free radical has one or more unpaired electrons; independent existence is also accepted when paired with this feature.

modelAnswer: An ion is an atom or group of atoms with a positive or negative charge because it has lost or gained electrons.
A free radical is an atom or group of atoms containing one or more unpaired electrons and capable of independent existence.
